title: Internal Trial Result Review Framework
completionDefinition: Phase 9B added internal trial result review, issue taxonomy, decision framework, fixtures, administrator panels, and internal trial result review documentation.

9B did not implement production app, public recruitment, backend, database, accounts, analytics, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, camera, AR, training, App Store/TestFlight, online publication, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, new runtime dependencies, or real user data collection.

9B did not collect real names, contact information, photos, health information, sensitive identity information, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Makeup Engine remains the template production system and UserAppTemplatePackage remains the handoff contract.
Docs and project-state must remain recoverable and validation commands must pass.
